memoryRelationsDescription: Review whether one memory confirms, contradicts, or extends another. Accepting a relation does not change facts, replace memories, or affect retrieval.
memoryRelationsPrivacy: Analyze sends this memory and up to 8 related memories in the same scope to your configured model. It checks a limited window of recent records, not every possible connection.
memoryRelationsIneligible: Analysis requires an active, non-private reference memory of at most 2,000 characters.
memoryRelationsError: Unable to complete this request. Refresh and retry. Check that your runtime is current and a model is configured. No memories were changed.
memoryRelationsEmpty: No suggestions for this memory. Analyze to look for related records; no result does not prove that no relation exists.
memoryRelationsStaleHint: An endpoint changed or became inactive. This relation cannot be used or reviewed. Analyze again for current evidence.
memoryDirectivesEnableDesc: Approved rules are sent to the model as your instructions on every turn. Turn off to keep rules stored but inactive.
memoryDirectivesDesc: Rules are injected as your instructions every turn; unlike reference memories they are not relevance-gated.
memorySetDirectiveDisabled: Rules must be short and user/workspace scoped; long content belongs in AGENTS.md
memoryAsDirective: Save as rule (applies to the model every turn)
memoryAsDirectiveDesc: Rules are sent to the model as your instructions, e.g. "reply in Chinese" or "run tests before committing". Ordinary memories are reference only and never executed as instructions.
memoryDirectiveTooLong: Rules must stay short; move long content to AGENTS.md
memoryImportDowngradedSuffix: record(s) were rules and were imported as reference; re-enable them one by one.
